task_description: Build 'IQ Study': a Vercel-deployable Next.js/TypeScript web app where a user uploads a book, the app analyzes it and generates a ranked set of ultra-high-probability exam questions tied to the user's curriculum, profiles the user's optimal learning method via an onboarding questionnaire on login, and drives an adaptive spaced-repetition / active-recall study loop (with a concept 'web' map) to reinforce conceptual mastery. AI is behind an LLMProvider abstraction with a deterministic mock fallback so the app builds and runs fully without an API key.

verification.summary: All 5 features complete. npm run lint, npm run typecheck pass clean; npm test = 62 tests across 13 files pass; npm run build succeeds with all 17 routes + proxy registered, all keyless via MockProvider + AUTH_SECRET dev fallback. Test quality verified: scheduler tests exercise real SM-2 interval growth/reset/ease-floor behavior, generateQuestions tests verify curriculum-overlap raises probability, session tests verify profile-adaptive ordering and due-only selection - each would fail if the covered logic were reverted. No Dockerfile in project so docker_build skipped.
